name: Honoring the life and legacy of Fiona the hippopotamus of the Cincinnati Zoo and Botanical Garden, and expressing the gratitude of the Senate to the staff of the Cincinnati Zoo for their extraordinary care and dedication
official: A resolution honoring the life and legacy of Fiona the hippopotamus of the Cincinnati Zoo and Botanical Garden, and expressing the gratitude of the Senate to the staff of the Cincinnati Zoo for their extraordinary care and dedication.

news.title: Did the Senate pass a resolution for Fiona the hippo? Yes, unanimously, the day after she died
US Senate honors beloved Cincinnati Zoo hippo Fiona following tragic death
Who is Bernie Moreno, the senator behind the Fiona the hippo resolution?

timeline.text: Senator Moreno paid tribute to Fiona the Hippopotamus, who recently passed away at the Cincinnati Zoo. He then received unanimous consent to agree to S.Res.967 to honor Fiona the Hippopotamus and the Cincinnati Zoo staff.
timeline.label: Passage
timeline.explain: The real vote on the measure itself. Done by unanimous consent: no recorded vote, because nobody objected.

timeline.text: Submitted in the Senate, considered, and agreed to without amendment and with a preamble by Unanimous Consent. (consideration: CR S5835; text: CR S5843-5844)
timeline.label: Amendment
timeline.explain: A vote on a proposed change, not on the bill itself.

timeline.text: 1:45 p.m. Senator Moreno paid tribute to Fiona the Hippopotamus, who recently passed away at the Cincinnati Zoo. He then received unanimous consent to agree to S.Res.967 to honor Fiona the Hippopotamus and the Cincinnati Zoo staff.
